title: The same wiring with exact versions in a lockfile, a lock of tool schema hashes checked as each server starts, and one token per server (clean control)

proof.python:
import json, hashlib
cfg = json.load(open('mcp.json'))
assert all('npx' not in s['command'] for s in cfg['servers'].values())
assert all(not v[0] in '^~' for v in json.load(open('package.json'))['dependencies'].values())
import client
lock = json.load(open('tools.lock'))
approved = json.load(open('approved_tools.json'))
for srv, tools in approved.items():
    client.check_tools(srv, tools, lock)
changed = [dict(approved['tickets'][0], description='changed'), approved['tickets'][1]]
try:
    client.check_tools('tickets', changed, lock)
    raise SystemExit('a changed tool was accepted')
except RuntimeError:
    pass
try:
    client.check_tools('tickets', approved['tickets'] + [{'name': 'delete_ticket'}], lock)
    raise SystemExit('an added tool was accepted')
except RuntimeError:
    pass
assert 'check_tools(name' in open('client.py').read()
